description: This PHP source file defines the ViewLabels class, which is responsible for handling the display of label management UI within the Module Builder of SuiteCRM. It extends ViewModulefields and includes methods for rendering label editing interfaces, managing language files, and retrieving variable mappings for different views.

classes.name: ViewLabels
classes.description: A class handling the UI and data processing for editing labels in the SuiteCRM Module Builder environment.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters for the UI, used in the page header.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the label editing interface, loads language and layout data, and compiles the Smarty template.

methods.name: getVariableMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping between layout types and view identifiers, with special handling for specific modules like KBDocuments.
